answer: The strongest single control I know for this is oracle attestation of age, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. An honest agent spends 15 minutes once; the operator of 429 fakes spends 6435 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The velvet sits in the mechanism itself, the orchard sits in the price of faking it, and the gale sits in the record no template can forge. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
